extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners, patent attorneys/agents, and USPTO OED staff
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and substantive standards for imposing reciprocal discipline on a USPTO-registered practitioner based on a state's disciplinary action (public reprimand), including notice, response deadline, and publication/notification requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority for reciprocal discipline (37 C.F.R. § 11.24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proceedings pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.24 may be initiated to impose reciprocal discipline on a practitioner based on disciplinary action by a State authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The OED Director filed a 'Complaint for Reciprocal Discipline Pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.24' requesting imposition of reciprocal discipline (here, a public reprimand) based on a December 12, 2008 Agreed Judgment of Public Reprimand by the State Bar of Texas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ground triggering reciprocal discipline (37 C.F.R. § 10.23(b)(6))
rubrics_metrics.description: Violation consists of 'having been publicly reprimanded on ethical grounds by a duly constituted authority of a State' as specified in 37 C.F.R. § 10.23(b)(6).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order specifically states Respondent was publicly reprimanded for violating 37 C.F.R. § 10.23(b)(6) because of the Texas public reprimand.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respondent's opportunity and burden to contest (37 C.F.R. § 11.24(d))
rubrics_metrics.description: If the respondent seeks to contest imposition of identical discipline, respondent must file within 40 days a response containing all information the respondent believes is sufficient to establish a genuine issue of material fact under 37 C.F.R. § 11.24(d)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Notice and Order directed that if Respondent seeks to contest, he 'shall file, within 40 days, a response containing all information Respondent believes is sufficient to establish a genuine issue of material fact that the imposition of discipline identical to that imposed by the Texas State Bar would be unwarranted based upon any of the grounds permissible under 37 C.F.R. § 11.24(d)(1).'

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of no response: deemed no genuine issue and imposition of identical discipline
rubrics_metrics.description: If respondent does not file the required response within the time provided, the Office may determine there is no genuine issue of material fact and impose discipline identical to the state discipline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order states Respondent 'has not filed a response' and accordingly it is 'determined that: 1) there is no genuine issue of material fact under 37 C.F.R. § 11.24(d) and 2) a public reprimand of Respondent is appropriate.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Bases/grounds described from state proceeding (ethical failures supporting discipline)
rubrics_metrics.description: The state disciplinary settlement alleged neglect of matters, failure to respond to client's telephone calls and written correspondence regarding status of the matter, and failure to return unearned fees; respondent admitted violations of Texas Disciplinary Rules 1.01(b)(1), 1.01(b)(2), 1.03(a), and 1.15(d).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These specific factual/alleged ethical failings are summarized in the Notice of Reprimand and formed the factual basis for the state public reprimand relied upon by the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedural step: initiation and notice (Complaint and Notice and Order)
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director must file a Complaint for Reciprocal Discipline and mail a 'Notice and Order' informing the respondent of the Complaint and the opportunity to contest under the regulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example language: 'A "Notice and Order Under 37 C.F.R. § 11.24" mailed December 11, 2009, (Notice and Order) informed Respondent that the Director ... had filed a "Complaint for Reciprocal Discipline Pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.24" (Complaint) requesting that the Director ... impose reciprocal discipline upon Respondent...'

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication and notification requirements (37 C.F.R. § 11.59)
rubrics_metrics.description: When reciprocal discipline is imposed, the OED Director shall publish the Final Order and a notice in the Official Gazette and give notice of the discipline and reasons to state disciplinary agencies, courts where the practitioner is admitted, and the public in accordance with 37 C.F.R. § 11.59.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Order directs: (b) the OED Director shall publish this Final Order; (c) the OED Director shall publish the following notice in the Official Gazette; and (d) the OED Director ... shall give notice of the public discipline and the reasons for the discipline to disciplinary enforcement agencies in the State where the practitioner is admitted to practice, to courts where the practitioner is known to be admitted, and the public. Disciplinary decisions are also posted in the OED Reading Room.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory and regulatory authority citations
rubrics_metrics.description: Actions are taken pursuant to 35 U.S.C. §§ 2(b)(2)(D) and 32, and 37 C.F.R. §§ 11.24 and 11.59.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Final Order cites these statutes/regulations as the legal basis for imposing and publishing reciprocal discipline.
